commits.body:
Read the original class-initialization log up to the observation boundary as well as inside it. Typed charset, member, live-table and ordered captures require a fresh application prestate and the selected root to initialize inside that window. Comparison JVMs use the same rule. A previously initialized class leaves a bound diagnostic with zero premises.

The changed-test selection passed all 56 groups, including 59 Rust binaries. Independent capped probes on the same reflective fixture verified arity zero on the cold launch and refused the already-initialized launch. Original Java returned the same String.trim member and arity in both. Job 20261127-023629-qualify-first-active-use-on-original-jvm repeats this control and the four-root Avro fix against all six original qualification matrices.
